quotes.text:
section .data
str: db 'Hello World', 0Ah
str_len equ $ - str
section .text
global _start
_start:
	mov eax, 4
	mov ebx, 1
	mov ecx, str
	mov edx, str_len
	int 80h
	mov eax, 1
	mov ebx, 0
	int 80h

push ebp
push edi
push esi
push ebx
sub esp, LocalVarsSize

LeaveLoopCmps: test eax, 0000FFFFh
	jnz LenLower
	add edx, 2
	shr eax, 16
LenLower: sub al, 1
	adc edx, 0
